text:
Someone got GTA 5 running in a Chrome tab. It lasted a few hours.
On October sixth, a site called Play GTA 5 went viral. No install. No console. You opened a browser tab and dropped straight into Los Santos.
The normal game is over a hundred gigabytes. This one loaded about seven hundred megabytes.
Story mode. Controller support. Even phones. Around sixty frames per second, according to players.
The clip on X passed one and a half million views.
But here's the twist.
Within hours, the site was gone. Now it just says, thanks for playing.
Reports point to Take Two, the company that owns Rockstar. And this has happened before. Last December, a Vice City browser port got taken down the same way.
Some say this one was built with AI and leaked source code.
Heads up: Rockstar hasn't confirmed any of this. And don't go hunting for copies. Most of them are scams.
Would you have played it? Tell me below.
